system.implants: Basic Biomods, Basic Mesh Inserts, Cortical Stack, Echolocation, Enhanced Hearing, Oxygen Reserve
system.advantages: +5 COO, +5 INT, +10 SOM, +5 to one other aptitude of the player’s choice, +40 Swimming skill, +20 Unarmed Combat skill, Bite Attack (2d10 DV, use Unarmed Combat skill)
system.disadvantages: Neo-orcas lack a sense of smell
system.description:
Though colloquially referred to as killer whales, orcas are actually members of the dolphin family. The average neo-orca length is 7 meters for males, 6 meters for females. Males also have larger and more triangular pectoral fins.

Notes: Large Size trait, Non-Human Biochemistry trait

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 65.
